quarterly_data.signal: Silicon Motion H1 2026 interim financial statements: two customers each accounted for 10% or more of net sales, together 48%: PHISEMI US$300,165 thousand (38%) and AFASTOR US$83,243 thousand (10%). In H1 2025 four such customers made up 59%: PHISEMI (25%), Kioxia (12%), Micron (11%) and a customer listed as 'Longys' (11%); Kioxia and Micron were each below 10% in H1 2026. The top ten customers accounted for approximately 78% of H1 2026 net sales (84% a year earlier). By bill-to location, H1 2026 revenue from China was US$508,134 thousand (US$204,677 thousand a year earlier) and from Israel US$62,188 thousand (US$157 thousand). Shenzhen Techwinsemi Technology (TWSC), a China module maker, is also named as one of its customers.
